tasks.title: Create the backend project: uv + Python 3.14 + FastAPI app factory, core/ (config, errors, ids) and folder structure
tasks.dod: `uv sync` succeeds in backend/ and `uv run python -c 'from calculate3d.main import create_app; create_app()'` exits 0; uvicorn binds 127.0.0.1 by default.

tasks.title: Wire the backend test harness + lint/type gates and the health smoke test (GET /api/health)
tasks.dod: `uv run pytest` passes an integration smoke test asserting GET /api/health returns 200 {"status":"ok","db":"ok"} and an unknown route returns RFC 9457 problem+json; `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `mypy --strict src` are green.

tasks.title: Set up SQLite engine (pragmas) + Alembic with timestamped SQL-first revisions and an initial empty migration
tasks.dod: `alembic upgrade head`, `alembic downgrade base`, `alembic upgrade head` all succeed against a temp SQLite file (covered by a pytest test); foreign_keys=ON and WAL are asserted on a fresh connection.

tasks.title: Create the web app: Vite + React + TypeScript + FSD layers, Tailwind + shadcn/ui primitives, TanStack Query, generated API types, Home page showing API health
tasks.dod: `npm ci && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run && npm run build` succeed in web/; a Vitest test renders the Home page with a mocked health response; Steiger reports no FSD violations; `web/src/shared/api/schema.d.ts` is generated from the backend OpenAPI.

tasks.title: Add the root Makefile (dev, run, check, api-check, web-check, migrate, migrate-down, api-types) and serve web/dist from FastAPI in `make run`
tasks.dod: `make check` is green end to end; `make run` boots one process on 127.0.0.1:8000 where `/` serves the built UI and `/api/health` returns ok (verified by a smoke test or scripted curl).

tasks.title: Add the CI workflow running `make check`
tasks.dod: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is valid YAML, sets up uv (Python 3.14) and Node 24, and runs exactly `make check`; no deploy job.

tasks.title: Write root CLAUDE.md (+ backend/ and web/ notes) from the foundation conventions
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md states the commands from the Makefile and every convention in docs/architecture-map.md §Conventions and §Frontend (layering, errors, IDs, money in kopecks, migrations, tests, FSD) and links ADR 0001-0004.

tasks.title: Review fix: health module follows router → service → repo, and reports db "down" when SQLite is unreachable
tasks.dod: `modules/health/` has router/schemas/service/repo/tables; `service.py` imports neither FastAPI nor SQLAlchemy; the SQL ping lives in `repo.py` and returns False on `SQLAlchemyError` (including failing to open a connection); GET /api/health returns 200 {"status":"ok","db":"down"} when the database is unreachable (integration test with a broken engine) and {"status":"ok","db":"ok"} otherwise; a unit test covers the service without I/O.

tasks.title: Review fix: every error is problem+json — catch-all 500, 422 envelope test, HTTP headers kept, unknown status safe
tasks.dod: An unhandled exception returns 500 `application/problem+json` with `code` "internal_error" and no exception text in the body; invalid request input returns 422 problem+json with `code` "validation_error", `type/title/status/detail` and `errors[]`; a 405 keeps its `Allow` header; an `AppError` with a status outside `HTTPStatus` (e.g. 499) renders problem+json with title "Error" instead of crashing. Each is asserted by an integration test.

tasks.title: Review fix: the server always binds 127.0.0.1 — no host setting can override it (ADR 0004)
tasks.dod: `Settings` has no `host` field; `run()` passes host "127.0.0.1" to uvicorn; a unit test asserts that host even with `CALC3D_HOST=0.0.0.0` in the environment.

tasks.title: Review fix: `make install` fails on a stale uv.lock (`uv sync --locked`)
tasks.dod: `make install` runs `uv sync --locked` in backend; it succeeds on the committed lock.

tasks.title: Review fix: `make check` fails when web/src/shared/api/schema.d.ts drifts from the backend OpenAPI
tasks.dod: `make api-types-check` regenerates the schema into a temp file and diffs it against the committed one; `make check` runs it; it is green now and fails after a hand edit of schema.d.ts; CLAUDE.md lists the target.

tasks.title: Review fix: health router depends only on its service; template layering documented
tasks.dod: `modules/health/router.py` imports `service` (+ schemas, core deps) but never `repo`; `service.py` still has no FastAPI/SQLAlchemy imports (the AST test stays green); the health-only exception (repo pings an `Engine`, not the per-request `Connection`, so a dead DB yields `db: "down"` instead of failing in the dependency) is stated in one sentence in architecture-map.md §Layering and CLAUDE.md; the architecture-map.md module inventory lists health as router · schemas · service · repo · tables.

tasks.title: Review fix: create_app(settings) uses settings.database_url
tasks.dod: `create_app` builds the engine from the `settings` it receives and keeps it on `app.state`; `get_engine` reads it from the request's app (no module-global engine built from `get_settings()`); an integration test proves an app from `create_app(Settings(database_url=<tmp>))` uses exactly that database and never touches `backend/var/`; test fixtures no longer need to override `get_engine`.

tasks.title: Review fix: the OpenAPI dump goes to a temp file, never the working tree
tasks.dod: `api:types` and `api:types:check` write the OpenAPI JSON to a `mktemp` file removed by `trap … EXIT` (works under macOS sh and Linux dash); a failed or interrupted run leaves no file under `web/`; `web/openapi.json` is listed in `.gitignore` and `web/.prettierignore` as a safety net; `make api-types` still regenerates an identical schema.d.ts and `make api-types-check` still fails after a hand edit.

tasks.title: Review fix: HomePage renders the db-down state
tasks.dod: `HomePage.test.tsx` has a case that mocks `{"status":"ok","db":"down"}` and asserts the visible label «База даних: не відповідає»; `make web-check` is green.

tasks.title: Review fix: integration tests enter TestClient as a context manager; engine-disposal note
tasks.dod: Every `TestClient(...)` in `backend/tests/` (incl. the four in `integration/test_errors.py`) is entered as `with TestClient(app) as client:` so the lifespan disposes `app.state.engine`; `backend/CLAUDE.md` replaces "Dispose any engine you create in a test" with "Always enter `TestClient(app)` as a context manager — the lifespan disposes `app.state.engine`"; `make api-check` is green.

tasks.title: Review fix: get_connection commits on success and rolls back on error
tasks.dod: An integration test builds `create_app(Settings(database_url=<tmp>))`, adds test-only routes using `Depends(get_connection)` that insert into a test-created table, and asserts the row is committed after a 200 and absent after a handler that raises (rollback). The root `CLAUDE.md` "Copy `modules/health/`" line notes that its Engine-based repo is the health-only exception and new repos take the `get_connection` Connection. `make api-check` is green.

tasks.title: Review fix: the R7 test proves there is no fallback to the default DB URL
tasks.dod: `test_app_database_settings.py` points `CALC3D_DATABASE_URL` at an unreachable sentinel (e.g. `sqlite:////nonexistent-dir/sentinel.db`) via monkeypatch + `get_settings.cache_clear()` and asserts `create_app(Settings(database_url=<tmp>))` reports `db: "ok"` — any fallback to `get_settings()` would report `down`; the settings cache is restored afterwards; `make api-check` is green.

tasks.title: Review fix: the api-types temp file is removed on INT/TERM under dash
tasks.dod: The `api-types` / `api-types-check` scripts add `trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM` after the EXIT trap so dash runs the EXIT trap (and its `rm -f`) on a signal; drift still exits non-zero, a match exits 0, nothing is left under `web/`; `make web-check` and `make api-types-check` are green.

tasks.title: Review fix: get_connection commits before the response is sent — a failed commit renders 500 problem+json
tasks.dod: `core/db.py` exports `ConnectionDep = Annotated[Connection, Depends(get_connection, scope="function")]` so the commit runs before the response is sent; `test_get_connection.py` uses `ConnectionDep`; a new integration test makes the commit fail (deferred FK violation) and asserts 500 `application/problem+json` and that no row is stored — it turns red if `scope="function"` is removed; root `CLAUDE.md` (and `backend/CLAUDE.md` / `docs/architecture-map.md` where they describe `get_connection`) name `ConnectionDep` as the way repos get their `Connection`; `make check` is green.
